title: doctor reports 3.4.0's wp.renumber events as an undeclared op after 3.5.0 retired the op
body:
3.5.0 removed `wp.renumber` from `event::KNOWN_OPS` when renumber was retired, but 3.4.0 wrote it, so every store whose log holds 3.4.0 history of a package renumber gets doctor's undeclared-op advisory for an op Intent itself wrote.

Expected (vc's ruling): a retired op stays known, marked retired, so history reads clean; event.rs's comment on the first retirement says so. Only wp.renumber is retired: remint still writes st.renumber and issues.renumber.

Found by ST0096's close-time catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H2-critic-rust-wp02-0709-20261122). Fixed under hv decision 86 for 3.5.1, dc's unit d86d.
